##Peep This peep is an AI favorite, though human players had played it before. It reinforces Black but creates potential for White. If Black does not connect, White will cut. , linking the black stones firmly together, is generally correct. See Toshiro Kageyama, *Lessons in the Fundamentals of Go*, p. 43.
is possible if [this ladder](17547) is unfavorable for White.
is also possible. See also [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 47, Tan Xiao 7p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lf0We2j5h8M&t=195s) and [*Game 57, Shin Jinseo 6p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PSfZEbgvT1c&t=123s).
